origin.description: Add indentation to a JSON string.

arguments.name: indent
arguments.text: Spaces to indent. A negative number uses tabs.

origin.details: The result ends with a newline.

translation.description: Parses with json and writes it back with an indent.

arguments.name: indent
arguments.text: Spaces to indent. A negative number uses tabs.

translation.details: A positive indent is spaces. A negative indent is tabs.
translation.example:
from jsonlite import prettify
print(prettify("[1,2]", indent=2), end="")
